name: Hazard ratio (HR)
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "A number comparing the rate of bad events in two groups. 0.5 means the risk is halved at any moment."
fields.after: "A hazard ratio is a number comparing the rate of bad events in two groups. An HR of 0.5 means the risk is halved at any moment."
